$comment: Parity ledger (ADR 0092). One item per capability that can differ between surfaces, with a status on ios, android, web (bipe-web) and server (bipe-api, bipe-infra): planned, built (merged, not in a tester build), testing (in a tester build), policy, or n/a with a reason. built and testing need evidence: paths that start with the surface's repo name. ios-new and android-new are Bipe's own client in bipe-app (Bipe Next, ADR 0143, bipe#579): their evidence starts with bipe-app/ios/ or bipe-app/android/ and is merged code, never a spec. Switch scope: an item built or testing on ios or android is built or testing on both new surfaces, or planned with the open issue that builds it (issue), or n/a with a reason and the ADR that excludes it (adr). The release surfaces stay ios and android until the switch. This is the one status per feature: product.json features have none, bipe-web and gen-product-doc.mjs read it by id. When iOS and Android differ, issue names the open issue that closes the gap (--issues checks that it is open). differences: deliberate behaviour differences between the apps; kind idiom, gap or undecided (gap and undecided need an issue). The Differences tables in both BIPE.md files are generated from it. Check: node tools/parity.mjs. Write the tables: --write. Report: --report.
